products.description:
The Relaunch of the LMF Signature Neoprene Collection

 

Debuting in 2009, the Genevieve Zip High-Waist Bikini has returned and remains a beloved favorite. This lingerie-inspired design features delicate seaming on the top for a structured, flattering fit and is accented by our signature scuba-inspired buckle. With a timeless elegance reminiscent of Brigitte Bardot, this chic bikini is perfect for poolside lounging.

 

The Zip High-Waist bottom sits comfortably at the waist, with an adjustable zipper that can be unzipped and folded down for tanning versatility. Artfully placed zig-zag seaming enhances the fit, providing both a secure feel and lean, sexy curves. This Genevieve Bikini is as stylish as it is functional. We suggest styling this bikini as an underpinning, like lingerie, for a more secure and polished look beneath your sheer Ready-To-Wear pieces. 

 

Crafted from our new, luxurious 1.0mm Neoprene, the fabric strikes the perfect balance—thinner and soft like traditional swimwear, yet maintaining the sculpting properties that make the body look great. 

 

Shown here in Black Neoprene. Fabrication: 1.0 mm Neoprene: Exterior: 84% Nylon, 16% Elastane. Interior: 100% Chloroprene.

 

Model is wearing Size 2.

 

Made in the U.S.A.

The Cobweb Gown takes inspiration from natures great seamstress, the spider. The intricate webwork has been hand crafted with an array of glistening crystals that catch and reflect light, resembling dewdrops on a spider's web in the morning sun.

The intricate hand beaded detailing is a work of true craftsmanship, sewn onto a base of delicate nude silk mesh to create a mesmerising labyrinth meant to resemble a spider’s web . The silk mesh perfectly hugs the body to create the perfect silhouette. The spider-web pattern is embellished with two-cut beads.

The gown comes with a dramatic train that trails your every step!

• Silk Mesh
• Hand beaded

products.description:
At Iris van Herpen, Haute Couture is governed by art, craftsmanship, innovation and personalisation. Inside the atelier, Couture is meticulously crafted as works of art. From gala dinners to red carpet events, premières to weddings, our customised Couture designs bring our clientele’s vision to life, harnessing the highest echelon of craftsmanship and innovation, creating visionary gowns which are suitable for any occasion, style or body. Each unique creation is guided at every step by Ms Iris van Herpen and the petit mains at our atelier based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. Our bespoke and bridal designs are meticulously crafted embracing the maison’s unique codes that celebrate movement and femininity — inspired by the natural world.

The Art of Haute Couture by Iris van Herpen stands for slow fashion, designing in a thoughtful and collaborative manner, paving the way for multi-disciplinary designs that extend the imagination.
